result.title: Close my account and take its Home offline
result.acceptance:
**Expected behaviour** · Require current password and explicit confirmation, identify the account and explain the 30-day recovery window and exact deadline. Close access and revoke credentials, sessions and pending account reset codes. Isolate the private Home by stable ID and protect the last owner.

**Verify** · Cancel and wrong password preserve access. Confirm with two live sessions and a second member. Retry after interruption, including failed file moves. The closed account and reused name cannot reach the retained Home. The remaining owner can sign in.

**Delivery dependencies** · WI-055, WI-064, WI-070

**Queue** · Follows WI-070 in the v0.3 delivery order.

**Target** · PI-03, v0.3.
